evidence_sufficient.instructions: Is the evidence sufficient to judge whether the acceptance items are satisfied (real code, tests, or command output rather than bare claims)?

criteria.true: evidence is empty, vague, or claim-only

verdict.instructions: What is the completion character of this issue given the evidence?

criteria.all_done: every acceptance item is demonstrated by the evidence
criteria.some_pending: at least one item is not demonstrated
criteria.not_started: the evidence does not correspond to the items at all
